cells.quote: On the testing set, the logistic regression model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.659, an accuracy of 0.825, a precision of 0.835, a recall of 0.980, a specificity of 0.115, and an F1-score of 0.902 (Table 3).
cells.note: This is a comparison of predictive models applied to observational survey data, not an instructional treatment comparison; logistic regression was higher on AUC, accuracy, recall, and F1-score, while XGBoost was higher on specificity and equal on precision.

cells.quote: Students in the Sim + LBL group scored significantly higher than those in the LBL group across total, subjective, and case analysis measures (all P < 0.05). The Sim + LBL group achieved median score differences of + 6.0 [95% CI 4.0–8.0], + 1.5 [0.5–3.0], and + 4.0 [3.5–5.0], respectively. Corresponding effect sizes (Cliff’s δ) indicated medium (–0.389), small (–0.165), and large (–0.605) effects (Table 2).
cells.note: The study compared consecutive cohorts rather than randomly assigning students.
